subject_exact: Lemon Squeezy feature limitations and non-US seller currency/fee exposure (review)
snippet_primary: "Feature Gaps: Compared to a full Stripe integration or larger platforms like FastSpring, LemonSqueezy has a narrower focus. It also lacks some advanced funnel customization. So if you need sophisticated checkout flows or alternative business models, you may outgrow it." and "Limited Payment Flexibility: LemonSqueezy's checkout is simpler, but that means fewer options. If you later need to expand beyond card/wallet payments, it may be restrictive. USD-Centric & Fees: All transactions settle in USD. This is fine for US-based creators, but non-US sellers pay extra due to currency fluctuations."
